beats.headline: Old highway car wash opens again
beats.body: The dusty wash on the highway has a new owner: one bucket, one bay and big plans. Its first customer drove off sparkling.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: This lot was my first business, forty years ago. Wash every car like it's your own and the town will keep coming back.

beats.headline: Roadside wash hires its first worker
beats.body: The highway wash now has a crew. Locals say the queue moves twice as fast.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: Now you're an owner, not just a washer. Let your crew scrub; you keep the cash moving.

beats.headline: Sparkle Express opens across town
beats.body: Chain owner Rex Goldsby has opened a shiny wash on the other side of town, and some drivers are heading his way. A faster way to wash big batches of cars could win them back.
beats.speaker: rival
beats.words: One bucket against my chain? Enjoy your quiet afternoons.

beats.headline: Sparkle Express closes its doors
beats.body: With a brush tunnel washing three cars at once, the roadside wash has won its customers back. Rex Goldsby's chain has pulled out of town.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: Better service beats a bigger sign, every time. He'll turn up again somewhere, mark my words.

beats.headline: Dust storm hits the highway
beats.body: A dust storm is rolling down the highway. For the next three minutes every car is filthy, and drivers will pay double for a wash.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: Storms are good for business, if you're ready for them. Keep every bay busy!

beats.headline: Storm clears, roadside wash shines
beats.body: The dust has settled. While the highway was a mess, the roadside wash kept every car moving.

beats.headline: Town unveils the Duck Fountain
beats.body: The town's new landmark stands by the roadside wash, paid for by its owner. Every bill in town now comes with a smile, and the owner has been seen looking at farmland out at Willowbrook.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: You've outgrown this lot. My brother Joe is selling his farmland out at Willowbrook. It won't come cheap, so save up, then go and see him.
